reports.title: Reports
reports.synthetic: Data up to and including {{date}} is synthetic: the history was generated for the demo (ml/synthetic_history.py).
reports.forecastIntro: Every night at 02:00 the system forecasts portions for the next days with two models: baseline_avg (the mean of the last 4 same weekdays) and gbm_v1 (gradient boosting). The menu gets the one that erred less over the last 2 weeks. Here: past forecasts against what was actually sold.
reports.forecastByDay: Portions per day: actual and forecast

promotions.title: Discounts
promotions.intro: Every 30 minutes the system proposes 30% off dishes that are left over and spoil soon, and 20% off empty slots in the next hour. A discount starts once you approve it.
promotions.approveHint: Once approved, people who bought this dish in the last 30 days get a notification (except those who turned off offers).
promotions.offPeakHint: A discount on the whole order picked up in the chosen slot. Starts right away.
